failure_found: The first real run correctly withheld promotion but rejected Debian's normal versioned GTK library symlink. Validation was corrected to accept only targets resolving to regular files inside the rootfs; an escape-link regression test was added.
final_delta: The final script adds quiet apt output and apt-get clean. The complete fresh install used the otherwise identical corrected validator; apt-get clean and the final script's idempotent path were then exercised directly on the tablet.
scope: This proves the locked Debian runtime phase on the working tablet. It does not yet prove the complete bootstrap from a factory-clean Termux install or generate final product launchers.
reuse: The required deja query returned no indexed implementation. This gate reuses the repository's locked patched PRoot, private staging, exact receipt, fail-closed validation, and same-filesystem rename-promotion patterns.
